title: Growth config: AUTOMATION_POLICY
description: Journey builder limits (GRW-P3-E extension). Frequency caps for custom journeys; they sit on top of COMMS_CAPS and LIFECYCLE_POLICY and can only tighten them. Holdout 0 until set. Added in 1.13.0. PROPOSED_DEFAULT until ratified. Unknown keys rejected.

cycleMinWaitMinutes.description: A loop needs at least this wait. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 1440.

maxSendsPer30Days.description: Across every builder journey for one person. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 4

holdoutPercent.description: Share of eligible people never messaged by builder journeys, for measurement. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 0.
